messages.author: cfddb3e3d4b1b855
messages.subject: Does Shinyapps allow `env` configurations?
parts:
Hi,
I am new here and I am deploying my shinyapps wanting to have access to data on aws S3 with my aws credentials. Those credentials are handled using `asw.s3` package having them as env variables. So I need to have those configs in the remote deploy.
I searched the `rsconnect` documentation, but couldn't find if there is a way to handle those env variables when I deploy me app. Has anyone encountered a situation similar? Your help is much appreciated!
